label: Secret bonus tier list: barrels, satchels and fireworks (rated for real in-combat use, NOT pre-combat barrelmancy)

items.verdict: spends a whole action for a -2 AC surface; he jokes it is basically casting True Strike
no-save 1d4 per turn over 20ft; occasionally fine early, though he could not find where it spawns
4d6+18 using YOUR OWN save DC, or break it for an alcohol surface you can freeze into ice
identical to the Oil Barrel but lighter to carry; 6d6 at DC12, no ice option, fiddly to place
6d6 DC12 plus an igniting oil surface, but less damage and less versatile than the Firewine Barrel
10d8+40 in a 59ft radius and auto-crits objects; ONLY FOUR EXIST and setup takes real work
the same nuke as the Runepowder Barrel, just a shorter model that is harder to hit at range
fireball-worth of force damage plus a no-save knockback long enough to shove enemies into pits
20ft wet field doubles all cold and lightning damage; he jokes about fanfiction and Berserkers hurling it
3d6 fire that flies straight to the target, but ITS COLOUR SPRAY IS BUGGED to zero duration
functionally identical to Popdrakes; a weak stand-in for Chromatic Orb with the same broken Colour Spray
identical again; usable as a Magic Missile substitute but not worth going out of your way for
8d6 only if dropped and ignited; THROWING IT IS BUGGED and does nothing. A or S tier if fixed
identical with a taller model; same broken throw, so hold one in case a patch repairs it
damage is marginal, but it survives being thrown and its no-save knockback repositions enemies precisely
6d6 at DC15 and throwable before igniting; he spends longer facetiously debating Teddy Roosevelt's place in Faerun
ONLY ONE IN THE GAME; more damage than the satchel, but the radius LIES and is triple what it shows
